action.rationale: Bg5 is the only commit-ready move: exact score 16 at depth 3, immediate-mate probe complete with no tactical refutation. It develops the undeveloped dark-squared bishop, contests the strong f5 bishop, and fits the plan of developing before castling. No material risk identified; Bxd3 on d3 is met by c2 recapture.
action.objective: Develop the dark-squared bishop to g5, pressuring f5 and preparing kingside castling, keeping the center solid.
